note: Every question type is shown once. Difficulty may be 1-5 or the words warm-up, easy, medium, hard, stretch. Answers may be given as an index, a letter, or the option text itself.

questions.text: The Moon produces its own light.
questions.explanation: We see the Moon because it reflects sunlight. It gives off no visible light of its own.

questions.text: Which gas do plants take in during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide and water go in, glucose and oxygen come out.

questions.text: A ball is thrown straight up. At the highest point of its flight, what is true of its acceleration?
options: It is zero, because the ball has stopped
It points downward at about 9.8 m/s²
It points upward at about 9.8 m/s²
It reverses direction at that instant
questions.explanation: Velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity never stops pulling, so acceleration stays downward the whole way.
Dolphins and bats are mammals despite swimming and flying. The platypus lays eggs and is still a mammal.

questions.text: Match each element symbol to its name.
questions.explanation: Several symbols come from Latin: natrium, kalium, ferrum, aurum.

questions.text: Put these stages of the water cycle in order, starting from the ocean.
What name is given to a star that suddenly brightens by a huge amount as it collapses at the end of its life?
questions.explanation: A supernova can briefly outshine its whole galaxy.

questions.text: Sound travels faster through steel than through air.
questions.explanation: About fifteen times faster. Tighter-packed particles pass the vibration along more quickly.
